title: docs(skills, spec): guard the nullable amount in the approval-flow and hook-condition examples
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x3jwBh95FgzuiJbPAUzCLYc)_

Fixes #31206

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a contract-review model mandate for `skills/**` (clause ①). That mandate is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). This card ran on the project's default model, and the dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review.

**Cross-seat note.** `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` (the `HookSchema.condition` `@example` and `.describe()` text) and its generated `content/docs/references/data/hook.mdx` row are spec-lane text. They ride along on this skills card under triage 6710970216, so the generated reference and the skill change together.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-automation` 技能的审批流示例，把开始节点条件改成 `record.amount != null && record.amount > 100000`；`HookSchema.condition` 的 `@example` 与 `.describe()` 改成 `record.status == 'closed' && record.amount != null && record.amount > 1000`，并用 `gen:docs` 重新生成 `hook.mdx`（只变这一行）。
- 为什么改：发布期空值守卫规则（`packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts`）会拒绝对可空字段做未守卫的大小比较，覆盖 hook `condition` 与 record_change 流程的开始/连线/分支条件；这两处示例照抄即被拒（#31206）。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档示例文字；spec 只改描述文本，不改 schema 形状，不移动任何接受集；技能文件 5727 / 5730 tokens，未动 ratchet 脚本；发版 `@objectstack/skills` 与 `@objectstack/spec` 各 patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`state-machines-and-approvals.md` L90；然后 `hook.zod.ts` L524 与 L526。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`（5727 / 5730）；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:docs`（hook.mdx 与源一致）；对照 `validate-expressions.ts` L2967-L2976 读「开始条件证明非空即在所有连线上被推定」。
- 需要你做的：`check-governed-merges` 判为 Tier H（`skills/**`、`packages/spec/**`），需 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准；请在席位契约复核 ACCEPT 后再批。

## What changes

### Guarded sites, before and after

| Site | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` L90, start `config.condition` | ``cel`record.amount > 100000` `` | ``cel`record.amount != null && record.amount > 100000` `` |
| same file L128, edge `e1` | ``cel`record.amount > 100000` `` | unchanged: presumed guarded by the start condition |
| same file L133, edge `e4` | ``cel`record.amount > 500000` `` | unchanged: presumed guarded by the start condition |
| same file L135, edge `e5` | ``cel`record.amount <= 500000` `` | unchanged: presumed guarded; a null `amount` never launches the flow, so it reaches neither branch |
| `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` L524, `@example` | `"record.status == 'closed' && record.amount > 1000"` | `"record.status == 'closed' && record.amount != null && record.amount > 1000"` |
| `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` L526, `.describe()` | ``P`record.status == "closed" && record.amount > 1000` `` | ``P`record.status == "closed" && record.amount != null && record.amount > 1000` `` |
| `content/docs/references/data/hook.mdx` L39 | generated from L526 | regenerated by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs` |

The guard is the form `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` teaches (≈L112-L122, `record.x != null && …`), the same form PRs #31127 and #31201 used. The rule is not restated in the automation skill.

**Nullability.** The example does not declare `opportunity`. The CRM example's `opportunity.amount` (`examples/app-crm/src/objects/opportunity.object.ts` L48) is `Field.currency({ label: 'Amount', min: 0 })`, with no `required`, no `defaultValue`, so it is nullable and the rule applies. Declaring it `required: true` was not needed.

### Regenerated `hook.mdx` diff (the only change in the generated tree)

```diff
-| **condition** | `string \| { dialect: Enum<'cel' \| 'cron' \| 'template'>; source: string; ast?: any; meta?: object }` | optional | Predicate (CEL); hook runs only when TRUE. e.g. P`record.status == "closed" && record.amount > 1000` |
+| **condition** | `string \| { dialect: Enum<'cel' \| 'cron' \| 'template'>; source: string; ast?: any; meta?: object }` | optional | Predicate (CEL); hook runs only when TRUE. e.g. P`record.status == "closed" && record.amount != null && record.amount > 1000` |
```

## Why

The publish-time null-guard rule (`packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts`, wired by `validate-expressions.ts`) refuses an ordering (`< <= > >=`) or arithmetic operator on a declared-nullable field unless an explicit `!= null` / `== null` / `isBlank()` test dominates it in the same boolean branch. It gates the lifecycle hook `condition` and, on a `record_change` flow, the start, edge and `decision` conditions. Both examples compared `record.amount` without a guard, so metadata written from them is refused at `os build` / `os validate` / `os lint` / the runtime publish gate.

## Deviations

1. **Narrowed from four sites to one (seat ruling).** The order listed the start condition and edges `e1`, `e4` and `e5`. On `main`, what the start condition proves non-null is presumed at every edge and `decision` branch, so only the start condition is guarded, spelled with `record.` so both doors accept it:
   - `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` L2967-L2976: `provenNonNullKeys(startConditionSource, …)` is passed as `presumed` to every after-start edge and branch check;
   - `packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts` L270-L273: "The start condition gates every run … what it proves non-null is presumed at every edge and `decision` branch of the flow; an author does not re-guard downstream.";
   - `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` L404: "What the start condition proves non-null is presumed at every edge and branch; spell that guard `record.budget != null`".
   `e5`'s `<=` stays honest: a null `amount` fails the start condition, so the flow never launches and neither `e4` nor `e5` is reached.
2. **No "edges inherit the start guard" clause.** The seat allowed one only if a same-file cut paid for it. The formula skill already teaches it (L404), so none was added and nothing was cut.

## Token readings (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, tokens = ceil(bytes / 4))

| File | `main` | This PR | Ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` | 22883 B = 5721 | 22908 B = 5727 | 5730 |

Growth is +25 bytes (`record.amount != null && `), which fits inside the headroom. **No deletions, so no deletion homes.** `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not touched (re-measured after merging `origin/main` `f8c3ecc4`: still 5727 / 5730).

## Eval cases touched

None. Swept `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/*.json` for `amount`, `100000`, `500000`, `budget` and approval conditions. `flows-triggers-approvals.json` case 3 (`crm_budget_approval`, "when `budget` increases past 100000") asserts only the approval shape (`type: 'approval'`, `approval_revise`, `type: 'back'`, `maxRevisions`, `revise`). No `must_contain` or `expected_output` spells an unguarded comparison, so no case rewards the unguarded form.

## Verification

- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.test.ts`: 1 file, **96 / 96 passed**.
- `check:skill-examples`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-refs`, the token ratchet and `check:docs`: exit 0 (in the gate list below). The approval fence carries no `<!-- os:check -->` marker, so `check:skill-examples` does not type-check it.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.

### Gates

## Other sites found (not changed here, for the seat to file)

|:--|:--|:--|

| `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` L145, start `condition` (`record.amount >= 50000 && …`) | `record_change` flow start condition on `opportunity` | **Yes**, if `amount` is nullable (the snippet doesn't declare the object; the CRM example's is nullable) |
